title: Noon in the Square
description: The letter's fate is public now — or its ash is. Noon will decide which story the city tells.

scenes.description: Market stalls fold under the heat. Bells count toward noon. House Veyra's grey cloaks ring the square like a polite noose. Your name is already on the wind.

choices.label: Climb the fountain and speak
choices.resultText: You take the high stone. Every face turns. This is theater with real knives.

choices.label: Slip the crowd and cut for the counting-house
choices.resultText: You vanish into bodies and awnings. The square will have its show without you — the captain waits inside.
choices.stakes: Quiet approach; face the boss in stone halls.

scenes.description: The crowd is a living thing. Grey cloaks tighten. Somewhere a crossbow clicks.

choices.label: Reveal what the letter held (or its ash)
choices.resultText: Truth, or the shape of it, hits the square like a thrown stone.
choices.stakes: End in speech — one of two endings.

choices.label: Draw steel when the cloaks rush
choices.stakes: Boss fight in the open square.

scenes.description: Marble and ledgers. Handler Veyra waits with tea that no one drinks. The Captain of the counting-house stands behind the desk like a verdict.

choices.label: Accept Veyra's pact
choices.resultText: A pin for your collar. A leash that cuts both ways.

choices.label: Challenge the Captain
choices.resultText: Ledgers spill. Steel sings in the marble.
choices.stakes: Boss fight for the house's heart.

scenes.description: Noon. The city hears you. Whether the letter lived or died, your voice is now a scar on House Veyra's ledgers. This ending is called The Tribune.

choices.label: Step down into the roar
choices.resultText: You are not free — but you are loud. The streets will retell this noon for years.

scenes.description: Blood on marble or cobble. The Captain falls or flees. House Veyra will not forget. This ending is called The Open Blade.

choices.label: Wipe the blade and walk
choices.resultText: Steel wrote the last line. The city makes room for the one who did the writing.

scenes.description: Silver at your throat. Handler Veyra smiles as if they invented the weather. This ending is called The Pin.

choices.label: Wear the pin into the rain
choices.resultText: Partnership is a story you tell yourself on the way to someone else's victory — unless you rewrite it later.
